input.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.fastestLapSpeed FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r.raceId IN (853, 854) ORDER BY r.raceId
